question: How do I enroll in the 401(k) retirement plan?
answer: Log in to the HR portal, open Benefits > Retirement, and choose your contribution percentage. New hires can enrol at any time; the company matches 50% of contributions up to 6% of salary. Changes take effect on the next payroll cycle.

question: How do I get reimbursed for a work-related business expense?
answer: Submit an expense report in the HR portal under Finance > Expenses within 30 days, attaching itemized receipts. Your manager approves reasonable work-related costs, including home-office equipment such as chairs, desks and monitors. Reimbursement is paid with the next payroll run.

question: How many paid vacation days do full-time employees receive per year?
answer: Full-time employees receive 5 paid vacation days per year.

question: What is the company policy on remote and hybrid work?
answer: Most roles follow a hybrid schedule of at least two days per week on site. Fully remote arrangements require director approval and are reviewed annually. Coordinate your in-office days with your team lead.

question: How do I request paid sick leave?
answer: Report sick leave in the HR portal under Time Off > Sick, ideally before your shift starts. Full-time employees accrue 10 paid sick days per year. A doctor's note is required for absences longer than three consecutive days.

question: What parental leave is available for new parents?
answer: Eligible employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave following a birth or adoption, which can be taken within the first 12 months. Submit the request at least 30 days in advance through Time Off > Parental Leave.

question: When are employees paid and how often?
answer: Payroll runs on the last business day of each month. Payslips are available in the HR portal under Payroll > Payslips two days before payday. Contact HR Services if your deposit has not arrived within one business day of payday.

question: How do I update my direct deposit bank account?
answer: Open the HR portal, go to Payroll > Bank Details, and enter your new account and routing numbers. Changes submitted before the 20th of the month apply to that month's payroll; later changes apply the following month.

question: How do I enroll in or change my health insurance?
answer: Health, dental and vision enrolment happens during onboarding and each year's open enrolment window. Outside those windows you can only change coverage within 30 days of a qualifying life event such as marriage or the birth of a child. Manage coverage under Benefits > Health.

question: What is the employee referral bonus program?
answer: If you refer a candidate who is hired and stays 90 days, you receive a referral bonus paid through payroll. Submit referrals through the recruiting portal before the candidate applies. Bonuses range from 1,000 to 4,000 depending on the role level.

question: How does the tuition reimbursement program work?
answer: The company reimburses up to 5,000 per year for job-relevant courses completed with a passing grade. Request pre-approval from your manager and HR before enrolling, then submit receipts and your grade to receive reimbursement.

question: How often do performance reviews happen?
answer: Formal performance reviews run twice a year, in June and December, with a lightweight mid-cycle check-in each quarter. Reviews combine self-assessment, manager feedback and peer input collected through the HR portal.

question: How much notice do I need to give when I resign?
answer: Employees are asked to give at least four weeks' written notice of resignation to their manager and HR. Your final payslip includes any accrued but unused vacation. An exit interview is scheduled during your notice period.

question: How do I report workplace harassment or a code-of-conduct concern?
answer: Report concerns to your manager, any HR business partner, or anonymously through the confidential ethics hotline linked in the HR portal. All reports are investigated promptly and retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is strictly prohibited.

question: How do I request new equipment or a hardware upgrade?
answer: Raise an equipment request in the HR portal under IT & Facilities > Equipment, with your manager's approval for items above the standard allowance. Standard laptops are refreshed every three years; accessibility equipment is provided on request.

question: What are the official company holidays this year?
answer: The company observes 11 public holidays plus two floating personal days you can take whenever you choose. The full holiday calendar is published in the HR portal under Time Off > Holiday Calendar at the start of each year.

question: What is the overtime policy for non-exempt employees?
answer: Non-exempt employees are paid 1.5 times their hourly rate for hours worked beyond 40 in a week. Overtime must be approved by your manager in advance and logged in the timekeeping system the same week it is worked.

question: How long is the probation period for new hires?
answer: New hires complete a 90-day probation period during which either party may end employment with one week's notice. A formal check-in at day 30 and day 90 confirms expectations and confirms permanent status.

question: How do I change my legal name or home address on file?
answer: Update personal details in the HR portal under Profile > Personal Information. A legal name change requires uploading supporting documentation; address changes take effect immediately and update payroll and benefits records overnight.

question: Can I carry over unused vacation days to next year?
answer: You may carry over up to five unused vacation days into the next calendar year, and they must be used by 31 March or they expire. Carryover balances are shown in the HR portal under Time Off > Balances.

question: What is the process to request an internal transfer or promotion?
answer: Discuss your interest with your manager, then apply to open internal roles through the careers portal. Employees are eligible to apply after 12 months in their current role. HR facilitates the interview process and any compensation review.

question: How do I access the employee assistance program (EAP)?
answer: The employee assistance program offers free, confidential counselling and financial and legal guidance, available 24/7 by phone and online. Access details and the helpline number are in the HR portal under Benefits > Wellbeing.

question: What learning and development resources are available?
answer: All employees have access to the online learning platform with thousands of courses, plus an annual professional development budget. Certifications relevant to your role can be expensed with manager approval under Development > Learning.

question: How do I set up or change my emergency contact?
answer: Add or edit emergency contacts in the HR portal under Profile > Emergency Contacts. We recommend keeping at least one contact on file and reviewing the details each year during the annual profile refresh.
